generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.description: The action could not be completed. Please try again.

network.title: Connection problem
network.description: Atlas could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

timeout.title: The request took too long
timeout.description: The server did not respond in time. Please try again.

cancelled.title: Request cancelled
cancelled.description: The request was stopped before it completed.

validation.title: Check the highlighted fields
validation.description: Some information needs to be corrected before saving.

unauthorized.title: Your session has expired
unauthorized.description: Sign in again to continue where you left off.

forbidden.title: You do not have access
forbidden.description: Your account does not have permission to view this page. Contact your administrator if you need access.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist or has been moved.

conflict.title: This item was changed elsewhere
conflict.description: Reload the page to see the latest version, then try again.

rateLimited.title: Too many attempts
rateLimited.description: Please wait a moment before trying again.

server.title: Server error
server.description: Something failed on our side. We are looking into it — please try again shortly.

unknown.title: Unexpected error
unknown.description: An unexpected problem occurred. Please try again.

boundary.title: This section could not be displayed
boundary.description: The rest of Atlas is still working. Try reloading this section.

entitlement.limitReached: You've reached your plan's limit for this. Upgrade your plan to continue.
entitlement.noSubscription: This organization doesn't have an active subscription yet.
entitlement.subscriptionInactive: Your subscription isn't currently active. Renew or upgrade your plan to continue.
entitlement.noPlanAvailable: No plan is currently available. Please contact support.

provisioning.stepFailed: Something went wrong while setting up your Academy. Please try again or contact support if the problem continues.

checkout.expired: This checkout has expired. Please start again.
checkout.notPayable: This checkout can no longer be paid.
checkout.planNotFound: The selected plan is no longer available.
checkout.pricingUnavailable: Pricing isn't configured for this plan and billing cycle yet. Please choose a different plan or contact support.
checkout.addOnNotFound: The selected add-on is no longer available.
checkout.planNoLongerExists: The plan for this checkout no longer exists.
checkout.addOnNoLongerExists: The add-on for this checkout no longer exists.

auth.emailNotAcceptable: Please use a permanent email address you can receive mail at. Temporary or disposable addresses aren't accepted.
auth.invalidVerificationToken: This verification link is invalid or has already been used. Request a new one to continue.

subscription.required: An active subscription is required to make this change.

concurrency.staleVersion: This content was changed by someone else while you were editing.

media.unsupportedFileType: That file type isn't supported. Upload a JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP or PDF.
media.invalidDataUrl: That file couldn't be read. Try choosing it again.
media.fileTooLarge: That file is too large to upload.
media.insufficientRole: You don't have permission to upload files to this academy.
